title: Reach the 42 unreached critical-tier mutants (TS-11 AC0 follow-up)
description: Follow-up for TS-11 AC0 (DEC-195 (2)). The critical-tier floor 0.80 stands; TS-11 is 258/(418-63) = 0.727, about 26 kills short. Aim first at the 42 UNREACHED mutants - those whose mutated line the corpus never executes (gate.py 33 of its 55 'equivalents'). First step: measure how many of the 42 an EXISTING test can reach through added parametrization, before any new test is written. Any slot request beyond the DEC-195 cap of 79 comes back with that number first.
implementationNotes: Per the leader: test-skills#13 (draft, test/TS-11-tmx-critical-floor) is HELD. It carries 14 collected cases (8 in test_cover_floor.py + 6 in test_gate_cli_inproc.py); dev is at 79, so it would take the suite to 93, 14 over the cap, and it cannot move under DEC-195 without its own amendment. Fold it into this task: when this task measures reach, say which of #13's 14 cases are the cheapest kills per slot, so any slot request beyond 79 carries that number.

INSTRUCTION, DEC-195 (6), 2026-10-20, relayed by the leader: test-skills#13 does not land (0.929 kills per added test, under DEC-195 (4)'s bar) and its value FOLDS INTO THIS TASK's parametrisation work.

Measured basis for that fold, at b7097a7, critical tier only, seed 20261014, per-line 1, mutant-set digest 222210827aa01053cd8fc32c56202671a4b1467dfb8f64cd844f5eb0aecd6bae:
- 72 mutants were unreached without #13 and 55 with it; the parametrisation candidates among the unreached are 41 and 38; import-time lines are 16 in both (13 rigor.PROFILES constants, 2 cover.py default-argument lines, 1 gate.py module constant, which no test can reach under this coverage model); functions no test touches are 15 and 1.
- Of #13's 13 kills, 6 were already reached but survived without it, and 7 were unreached; of those 7, three sit in functions existing tests already exercise (cover.py certificate and check_certificate) and four are in gate.py main (3) and write_baseline (1), which nothing else attributes.

CAVEAT that sizes this task: the matrix attributes no coverage to a subprocess, so gate.py main reads unreached without #13 although two existing tests drive the CLI that way. The 15 untouched functions are an UPPER BOUND on what needs a new test, and #13's in-process tests were the only attributed coverage of it.

CONDITION on the four unique reaches: they may come back ONLY as a measured slot request sized with this task's result, never on their own.

Budget: the cap is 84 and unamended. Any test this task needs is still a measured slot request to the leader, sized with this task's own measurement rather than assumed.
